works.title: Cementitious Waterproofing
works.description: Existing reusable work catalogue identity used to demonstrate ARC + WMS + ITP separation and traceability.

Labor: Contractor-provided labour requirement is recorded separately from tools/materials.
Safety: Fire control where hot-work/equipment requires it
Preconditions: Access, water, power and weather readiness checked

wms.title: Authority & scope check
wms.note: Confirm approved drawing, specification, product system and project-specific method before physical work.

wms.title: Substrate readiness
wms.note: Inspect and prepare the work surface; record defects requiring repair before proceeding.

wms.title: Repairs & interfaces
wms.note: Treat cracks, joints, corners, penetrations and drainage interfaces only to the approved system/detail.

wms.title: Application sequence
wms.note: Execute the approved manufacturer's/project method; this demo deliberately does not invent coat thickness, mix ratio or curing duration.

wms.title: Inspection / test
wms.note: Complete the governed inspection/test requirement before covering the waterproofing.

wms.title: Protection & records
wms.note: Protect accepted work and link photos/evidence/as-built records to the real execution identity.

works.wms_notice: Illustrative sequencing only. Numerical mix ratios, coat thicknesses, curing periods and acceptance values must come from the approved project system, manufacturer specification and applicable verified requirements.

itp.criteria: Applicable approved documents, substrate and interfaces are verified.
Work follows the approved system and workmanship controls; deviations are recorded, not guessed.
Required inspection/test is passed and evidence is attached to a real execution record.

mapping.IfcOpenShell: sequence/resource/cost APIs as future calculation/manipulation engine

works.title: Construction of Soak Pit
works.description: Research-gated example showing how unresolved identity and technical requirements are handled without fabricating a standard.

Labor: Crew roles to be resolved from approved execution plan.
Equipment: Excavation/dewatering/access equipment only where required by verified site conditions
Materials: Stone/aggregate/masonry/pipe/cover/filter materials only after design and specification are verified

wms.title: Resolve canonical work identity
wms.note: Check work catalogue / BOQ authority before registering a new work_id.

wms.title: Verify design basis
wms.note: Resolve users/hydraulic basis, site suitability and governing authority requirements.

wms.title: Clause-level technical research
wms.note: Record code, edition, clause/table/figure and applicability for every numerical requirement.

wms.title: Develop construction sequence
wms.note: Only after authority is resolved: setting out, excavation, base/walls/inlet/cover/backfill/inspection/as-built sequence.

wms.title: Engineering check of local alternative
wms.note: The described two-rebar local support practice remains user-supplied and unapproved pending structural/durability/detail verification.

works.wms_notice: No soak-pit dimensions, mortar ratio, weep-hole spacing, reinforcement size or separation distance is asserted here. Those values remain research/design gates.

itp.criteria: Applicable design and authority requirements are resolved before execution template is approved.
Actual soil, groundwater, utilities and safe excavation conditions are recorded.
Real inspection, photos/as-built information and acceptance are captured before closeout.
